🚀 NEW on We ❤️ Open Source 🚀

Learn Linux TV explores 5 common cloud mistakes, including monitoring blind spots, failed snapshot retention, exposed credentials, and governance policies that aren't enforced.

One real-world example resulted in more than $30,000 in unnecessary monthly charges. Regular audits and automated safeguards can make a significant difference.
